strings.en: Hehehe, there's nothing to be afraid of.
Once broken, all lives are the same.
Now that you're in my sight, you won't get off lightly.
Your fate will end by my hand!
Your luck ran out when you came here.
Did you think you had a chance one-on-one?
You have no chance of winning.
Trying to let your comrades escape? How foolish.
That something calls out between you and me...
I'd rather not think of it as fate.
If I can erase your existence here...!
To get a lead... first I'll destroy the machine.
Even if you bring out that defective product...
The R Series is nothing but defective products.
To think you'd go this far...!
The fate you'll meet is already decided...!
Your blade will never reach my life...!
That tenacity will soon run out...!
SRX... No need to hold back, then...!
It seems you can fight me as an equal.
...You think that gives you a chance to win?
You don't know when to give up.
Do you mean to waste your comrades' sacrifice?
You're an important lead. Now, at least.
Just a bunch who were used by that man...
Your Tronium Engine seems to be acting up.
The R Series... They seem a bit stronger.
I'll give you credit for your momentum, at least.
So, what result were you hoping for?
Is that how you mean to avenge your comrades?
No doubt about it. The one piloting that is...
Is this all the SRX Team can do?
There was no point in combining.
You intend to fight me without combining?
Give up and accept your fate.
I can read your every move.
I thought you'd do that, Vete.
You came at me with that little skill?
That trick won't work on me.
Your offense and defense seem out of balance.
I'll toy with you using illusions!
